targets.expr: max by (device, family, model, version, site) (junos_device_info{device=~"$SHORTNAME"})

max(avg by (device, component_name) (junos_components_power_zone_0_allocated{device=~"$SHORTNAME", component_name=~".*(?i)chassis.*"}) + avg by (device, component_name) (junos_components_power_zone_1_allocated{device=~"$SHORTNAME", component_name=~".*(?i)chassis.*"}))

max(avg by (device, component_name) (junos_components_power_zone_0_usage{device=~"$SHORTNAME", component_name=~".*(?i)chassis.*"}) + avg by (device, component_name) (junos_components_power_zone_1_usage{device=~"$SHORTNAME", component_name=~".*(?i)chassis.*"}) + avg by (device, component_name) (junos_components_power_system_usage{device=~"$SHORTNAME", component_name=~".*(?i)chassis.*"}))
